transcript: I know I've talked about how much I love this show on this page many times before, but I've yet to give it a proper review. So let's fix that. And I just wanna start out by saying everything you have heard is true. The hype is real, and this show is not to be missed. I think that this is Jamie Lloyd at his best. Every single device that he utilizes in the show works incredibly well. The show opens and ends with a credit sequence and obviously uses a lot of live footage throughout, giving it a very cinematic feel, which, of course, makes sense given that Norma Desmond, our central character, is a Hollywood starlet. And let's talk about Nicole Scherzinger, who plays Dorma Desmond, because she is giving a top five best stage performance I've ever seen. What she is doing in the show, in this role, is absolutely unreal. Like, obviously we know vocally she's gonna be incredible, but her acting and her physicality that she is bringing into the role is just as good. She is one of those performers where every time she is on stage, you cannot help but be completely transfixed by what she's doing. And because of this, anytime she wasn't on stage, I just kept finding myself wishing that we could get back to the Norma Desmond stuff. And that's no shade to the other actors in the show who are giving great performances. I think this is a Flaw with the show itself. All of the good songs are given to Norman Desmond. All of the interesting dialogue is given to Norma Desmond. The other actors are doing the best with the material they are given, but they are also given peanuts. Comparison Nicole Scherzinger, who has given an entire five course meal and is absolutely devouring every single bite. That being said, I do really like the way the ensemble is utilized in this production. The choreography is by Phoebe and Eloise. I hope I'm saying that right. And while this is not a super dance heavy show, the choreography that is there is incredible and I really hope that he is rewarded for it come award season. Overall, while I may find Jamie Lloyd to be very hit or miss, I famously did not like his Romeo and Juliet. I think this is Jamie Lloyd at his absolute best, and the phenomenal central performance by Nicole Scherzinger makes this an absolute must see. I mentioned this in my October Theater Recommendations video, but if bears repeating, I really do think tickets to this are going to be extremely hard to get once it opens and as word of mouth spreads. So if you do not already have tickets, I highly recommend getting your tickets now and definitely checking out Sunset Boulevard.
